digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, Python, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理提供技能、记忆与安全优化，让代理更高效可靠

repos.name: anthropics/claude-code
repos.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, ex
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的智能编程助手，理解代码库并自动执行日常任务、解释复杂逻辑与处理 Git 流程

repos.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: 为 AI 编码 Agent 注入生产级工程技能，让生成的代码更贴近成熟工程师水准

repos.name: stablyai/orca
repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote
repos.summary_zh: 让多个编码 Agent 并行协作的 ADE，支持自带订阅跨桌面移动与远程运行

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: rustfs/rustfs
repos.description: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms
repos.summary_zh: 兼容 S3 的高性能 Rust 对象存储，可与 MinIO、Ceph 平滑迁移共存

repos.name: makepad/makepad
repos.description: Makepad is a creative software development platform for Rust that compiles to wasm/webGL, osx/metal, windows/dx11 linux/opengl
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写一次即可跨平台编译到 Web、macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的创意应用开发框架

repos.name: hydra-db/hydradb
repos.description: HydraDB - fast graph database on object storage
repos.summary_zh: 基于对象存储构建的极速图数据库，用 Rust 实现，让海量图数据低成本存储与高性能查询兼得

repos.name: BenyRonald77/uajy-academic-rag-chatbot
repos.description: Production-grade RAG chatbot for Universitas Atma Jaya Yogyakarta academic handbook with Streamlit, FAISS vector search, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Streamlit与FAISS向量检索的校园学术手册RAG问答机器人，接入Gemini 2.5 Flash实现精准问答

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: supermemoryai/supermemory
repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: 为 AI 应用打造的超高速本地可运行记忆与上下文引擎，让模型拥有持久记忆

repos.name: EricLBuehler/mistral.rs
repos.description: Fast, flexible LLM inference
repos.summary_zh: Rust 编写的高性能 LLM 推理引擎，支持多模型与量化，兼顾速度与灵活部署

repos.name: datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang
repos.description: Official SGLang x Datawhale course on LLM inference: understand inference, build a mini-sglang from scratch, then read the real SGLang source and land
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写 mini-sglang 再读真实源码，Datawhale 出品的 LLM 推理引擎实战课助你拿下首个 PR

repos.name: Thinking-Space/One-Shot-OPD
repos.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
repos.summary_zh: 仅需一个训练样本即可完成大模型在线策略蒸馏，重新审视并简化 LLM 蒸馏流程

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch
repos.description: A straightforward method for training your LLM, from downloading data to generating text.
repos.summary_zh: 从零手写训练大语言模型的完整流程，覆盖数据下载到文本生成，适合想深入理解 LLM 底层原理的开发者

repos.name: whitecircle/halo
repos.description: Halo is an open-source framework built by White Circle for training large language and multimodal models
repos.summary_zh: 支持异步强化学习与分布式训练的大模型及多模态训练框架，内置GRPO和Agent能力，让微调更高效

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev
repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 的现代跨平台代理客户端，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供优雅易用的定制化网络代理体验

repos.name: farion1231/cc-switch
repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.i
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面端 AI 编码助手统一管理工具，一站式切换配置 Claude Code、Codex 等六种 Agent

repos.name: rust-lang/rust
repos.description: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
repos.summary_zh: 赋能开发者构建可靠高效软件的系统级编程语言，以内存安全与零成本抽象兼顾性能与安全

repos.name: tauri-apps/tauri
repos.description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造跨平台桌面与移动应用，前端复用 Web 技术，体积更小更快更安全

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: pytorch/pytorch
repos.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repos.summary_zh: 深度学习框架标杆，以动态计算图和强大GPU加速让神经网络开发像写Python一样灵活高效

repos.name: upscayl/upscayl
repos.description: 🆙 Upscayl - #1 Free and Open Source AI Image Upscaler for Linux, MacOS and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: 免费开源的跨平台 AI 图像放大工具，本地运行即可无损提升图片分辨率

repos.name: ZuodaoTech/everyone-can-use-english
repos.description: 人人都能用英语
repos.summary_zh: 用 AI 把英语学习拆成可执行训练流程的开源工具，让普通人也能系统练好听说读写

repos.name: JustVugg/colibri
repos.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repos.summary_zh: 纯C零依赖的微型推理引擎，让普通硬件也能跑前沿MoE大模型，专家权重从磁盘流式加载

papers.summary_zh: 提出仓库级动态执行推理基准，通过真实运行时行为评估LLM，揭示其动态推理能力显著不足

papers.title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reordering a set of mathematical rules without changing its meaning should preserve the correct answer, but must a model's internal representations stay invariant too? We investigate this question usi
papers.summary_zh: 通过多序函数组合任务揭示数学推理模型答案顺序不变但内部表征顺序敏感，为表征一致性评估提供新视角

papers.title: MultiVENT-Raw: A Benchmark for Retrieval and Reasoning over Raw Videos
papers.abstract: Online information is increasingly consumed in video format. Much of this comes in the form of *raw video*: continuous footage taken on a cell phone, with a hand-held camera, or via CCTV, which is the
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向原始视频检索与推理的多语言基准MultiVENT-Raw，覆盖手机手持监控等真实场景，揭示当前模型在事件定位与跨模态推理上的显著不足

papers.title: Where Should I Join? Robot Group Joining via Language-Guided Goal Prediction

papers.summary_zh: 提出语言引导的目标预测方法实现机器人动态群体加入，无需预设目标即可根据实时活动与队形推断最佳加入位置

papers.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents

papers.summary_zh: 提出面向LLM智能体的编辑式世界模型，通过预测状态编辑而非重建观测，降低高熵工具结果建模难度并提升长程任务表现

papers.title: Shopping by algorithm: How agentic AI deploys human heuristics as a surrogate consumer
papers.abstract: Consumers increasingly delegate purchasing decisions to Large Language Models (LLMs) acting as surrogate consumers. Using "Tool-Lab," an adaptation of information-board process tracing that places pro

papers.title: On the Diffusibility of High-Dimensional Latents

papers.title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
papers.abstract: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow ne

papers.title: Context-Continuous Preference Learning for Exoskeleton Personalization
papers.abstract: Personalizing exoskeleton assistance across operating conditions is constrained by the time and physical effort required to collect user feedback. We examined whether a user's preference landscape var

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification

papers.title: StudentBench: AI and human tutoring yield equivalent GRE learning gains
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence offers an unprecedented opportunity to augment human capabilities, yet progress at the frontier has focused primarily on advancing model capabilities. We introduce StudentBench
